import sys
import math

class BufferedInput:
    def __init__(self, is_stream):
        self.in_stream = is_stream
        self.buf = bytearray(1024)
        self.idx = 0
        self.len = 0

    def read_byte(self):
        if self.len == -1:
            raise Exception("Input mismatch")
        if self.idx >= self.len:
            self.idx = 0
            try:
                self.len = self.in_stream.readinto(self.buf)
            except Exception:
                raise Exception("Input mismatch")
            if self.len <= 0:
                return -1
        res = self.buf[self.idx]
        self.idx += 1
        return res

    def read_integer(self):
        c = self.read_byte()
        while self.is_space(c):
            c = self.read_byte()
        sign = 1
        if c == ord('-'):
            sign = -1
            c = self.read_byte()
        res = 0
        while not self.is_space(c):
            if c < ord('0') or c > ord('9'):
                raise Exception("Input mismatch")
            res = res * 10 + (c - ord('0'))
            c = self.read_byte()
        return res * sign

    def is_space(self, c):
        return c == ord(' ') or c == ord('\n') or c == ord('\r') or c == ord('\t') or c == -1


class Algorithm:
    MAX_LEN = 1 << 20
    cCos = [0.0] * MAX_LEN
    cSin = [0.0] * MAX_LEN
    cConjCos = [0.0] * MAX_LEN
    cConjSin = [0.0] * MAX_LEN

    @staticmethod
    def init_tables():
        for size in range(1, Algorithm.MAX_LEN + 1, size if size > 1 else 1):
            if size > Algorithm.MAX_LEN:
                break
            half = size >> 1
            for i in range(half, size):
                angle = 2 * math.pi * (i - half) / size
                Algorithm.cCos[i] = math.cos(angle)
                Algorithm.cSin[i] = math.sin(angle)
                Algorithm.cConjCos[i] = math.cos(-angle)
                Algorithm.cConjSin[i] = math.sin(-angle)
            if size == 1:
                break

    def run(self, test_idx, reader, writer):
        MOD = 998244353
        n = reader.read_integer()
        k = reader.read_integer()
        base_vector = [0] * 10
        for _ in range(k):
            idx = reader.read_integer()
            base_vector[idx] = 1

        current_result = [1]
        exp = n // 2

        while True:
            if exp & 1:
                current_result = self.poly_multiply(current_result, base_vector, MOD)
            exp >>= 1
            if exp == 0:
                break
            base_vector = self.poly_multiply(base_vector, base_vector, MOD)

        total_sum = 0
        for x in current_result:
            total_sum += x * x
        writer.println(total_sum % MOD)

    def poly_multiply(self, A, B, mod):
        required_len = len(A) + len(B) - 1
        n = max(2, 1 << (required_len - 1).bit_length())

        ar = [0.0] * n
        ai = [0.0] * n
        for i in range(len(A)):
            val = ((A[i] % mod) + mod) % mod
            ar[i] = val & ((1 << 15) - 1)
            ai[i] = val >> 15

        self.transform(ar, ai, False)

        br = [0.0] * n
        bi = [0.0] * n
        for i in range(len(B)):
            val = ((B[i] % mod) + mod) % mod
            br[i] = val & ((1 << 15) - 1)
            bi[i] = val >> 15

        self.transform(br, bi, False)

        cr = [0.0] * n
        ci = [0.0] * n

        for i in range(n):
            j = (n - i) & (n - 1)
            a1r = (ar[i] + ar[j]) * 0.5
            a1i = (ai[i] - ai[j]) * 0.5
            a2r = (ai[i] + ai[j]) * 0.5
            a2i = (ar[j] - ar[i]) * 0.5

            b1r = (br[i] + br[j]) * 0.5
            b1i = (bi[i] - bi[j]) * 0.5
            b2r = (bi[i] + bi[j]) * 0.5
            b2i = (br[j] - br[i]) * 0.5

            cr[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r
            ci[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i

        self.transform(cr, ci, True)
        output = [0] * required_len
        for i in range(required_len):
            p = round(cr[i])
            q = round(ci[i])
            r = round(ci[n - i]) if i > 0 else round(ci[0])
            output[i] = int((p + ((q % mod) << 15) + ((r % mod) << 30)) % mod)
        return output

    def transform(self, real, imag, is_inverse):
        n = len(real)
        bits = 32 - (n & -n).bit_length() if n > 0 else 0
        for i in range(1, n):
            j = int(bin(i)[2:].zfill(bits)[::-1], 2)
            if i < j:
                real[i], real[j] = real[j], real[i]
                imag[i], imag[j] = imag[j], imag[i]

        len_val = 2
        while len_val <= n:
            half = len_val >> 1
            step = len(Algorithm.cCos) // len_val

            base = 0
            while base < n:
                w_idx = 0
                for offset in range(half):
                    w_real = Algorithm.cConjCos[half + offset] if is_inverse else Algorithm.cCos[half + offset]
                    w_imag = Algorithm.cConjSin[half + offset] if is_inverse else Algorithm.cSin[half + offset]

                    idx1 = base + offset
                    idx2 = base + offset + half

                    u_re = real[idx1]
                    u_im = imag[idx1]
                    v_re = real[idx2] * w_real - imag[idx2] * w_imag
                    v_im = real[idx2] * w_imag + imag[idx2] * w_real

                    real[idx1] = u_re + v_re
                    imag[idx1] = u_im + v_im
                    real[idx2] = u_re - v_re
                    imag[idx2] = u_im - v_im

                    w_idx += step
                base += len_val
            len_val <<= 1

        if is_inverse:
            inv_n = 1.0 / n
            for i in range(n):
                real[i] *= inv_n
                imag[i] *= inv_n


class PrintWriter:
    def __init__(self, out_stream):
        self.out = out_stream

    def println(self, text):
        self.out.write(str(text) + '\n')
        self.out.flush()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    Algorithm.init_tables()
    is_stream = sys.stdin.buffer
    os_stream = sys.stdout.buffer
    reader = BufferedInput(is_stream)
    writer = PrintWriter(os_stream)
    alg = Algorithm()
    alg.run(1, reader, writer)
